evidence.reason: The final launch boundary after the snapshot and review-diff scans rechecks only the wall-clock deadline and GLM blackout, then dispatches to the selected driver. It does not revalidate the selected provider's shared cooldown, so a cooldown persisted by another worker during scanning is ignored and a call can start on a provider already known to be rate-limited. This is a TOCTOU gap in existing admission behavior, not a new requirement. No supplied fixing commit addresses it; 3f8467d only added the dispatch-deadline handling.
